papers_read.title_as_printed: Identifying underlying patterns in Alzheimer's disease trajectory: a deep learning approach and Mendelian randomization analysis (Yi et al., eClinicalMedicine 2023)
Predicting Progression from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease using MRI-based Cortical Features and a Two-State Markov Model (Ficiara et al., ISBI 2021)

what_each_reports.P-244: Deep-AD (transformer VAE survival clustering) on ADNI MCI->AD (783 MCI, 348 converters), 5-fold CV; inputs = baseline clinical variables (MMSE, ADAS, CDRSB, FAQ, APOE4, demographics etc.) plus FreeSurfer Destrieux MRI features. Time-dependent AUC for MCI->AD 0.914 at 3 years and 0.957 at 5 years (range 0.810-0.979 over 1-10 years); C-index 0.718; external AIBL C-index 0.752.
what_each_reports.P-198: Two-state Markov model with 5 MRI covariates, then logistic regression, ADNI1/2 (721 MCI: 533 sMCI, 188 converters), stratified 10-fold CV, conversion within ~2 years. AUC 0.78 +/- 0.08 (cortical thickness covariates), 0.71 +/- 0.09 (sulcal width), 0.56 +/- 0.10 (baseline, no covariates).

quantity_a: Time-dependent ROC-AUC at a 5-year horizon for MCI-to-AD conversion, ADNI, predictors = clinical/cognitive/genetic variables plus MRI morphometry, 5-fold CV
quantity_b: ROC-AUC for conversion by the second visit (~2 years), ADNI1/2, predictors = five FreeSurfer cortical-thickness covariates only (MRI-only), 10-fold CV
incompatible_if_same: Even setting the horizons aside, a clinical-plus-MRI model outscoring an MRI-only model is expected, not contradictory; neither paper claims an ordering the other refutes. The two do not estimate the same discrimination quantity.

gates.task: match in label (MCI-to-AD conversion, T2) but the horizon differs: 5 years vs ~2 years.
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI (P-244 ADNI1/GO/2/3; P-198 ADNI1/2) - overlapping participants likely.
gates.validation_tier: match: both internal cross-validation for the quoted figures (P-244 also has an AIBL external C-index, not the quoted AUC).
gates.modality_family: mismatch in predictor set: P-244 combines cognitive/clinical scores (CDRSB, ADAS11, MMSE, FAQ), APOE4 and MRI; P-198 uses structural MRI cortical thickness only.

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: both ROC-AUC, but P-244's 0.957 is a time-dependent AUC at 5 years from a survival model, P-198's 0.78 is a 2-year classification AUC.
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.957 is below 0.97, internal CV on a large sample (783) with an external cohort also reported; not a valid performance comparison anyway given different horizons and predictors.
independence: Distinct groups (Zhejiang/PUMCH vs Turin/USC); both draw on ADNI MCI participants, so cohort overlap is likely (non-independence).
grounds: P-244's 0.957 is a 5-year time-dependent AUC; P-198's 0.78 is for conversion within about two years, so the endpoints differ in horizon.
P-244's predictors include cognitive and clinical scores plus APOE4 alongside MRI, while P-198 uses five MRI cortical-thickness covariates only, so the predictor sets differ.
With endpoint horizon and predictor set both different and no waiver on record, the two AUCs are not estimates of the same quantity.

evidence_quotes.quote: AUC (CN→MCI, 3 years 0.802, 5 years 0.876; MCI→AD, 3 years 0.914, 5 years 0.957).
we concatenated the baseline clinical features and neuroimaging features extracted from the MRI scans, embedded with t through a transformer encoder, to map to z.
For evaluation, we applied five-fold cross validation
using λ to predict whether a test patient will transition to AD within the next two years, given the outcome of the first visit.
sulcal width (AUC=0.71 ± 0.09; Accuracy= 0.72 ± 0.04) and cortical thickness (AUC=0.78 ± 0.08; Accuracy= 0.75 ± 0.02) compared to the baseline model (AUC=0.56 ± 0.10; Accuracy=0.65 ± 0.08).

record_defects: resolution_note 'Confirmed genuine: Same metric type (AUC); Gap magnitude 0.177 exceeds threshold' ignores the 5-year vs 2-year horizon and the clinical-plus-MRI vs MRI-only predictor sets.
resolution field 'Rejected - false positive' and resolution_status 'partially_resolved_candidate' contradict the note's 'Confirmed genuine'; the record is internally inconsistent.
P-244 registry Best_Metric 'AUC 0.802' is the CN->MCI 3-year AUC, not the MCI->AD figure; Sample_N_Approx 587 is the CN->MCI dataset (MCI->AD is 783).
P-198 registry Best_Metric 'AUC 0.56' is the no-covariate baseline model, not the best model (0.78).
what_would_change_the_verdict: An AUC from P-244 at a ~2-year horizon using MRI features only, compared against P-198's 0.78 with non-overlapping uncertainty; P-244 reports neither.
